rows.title: Norm-certified dyadic finite-word Fourier tabulation
rows.status: Supported proof-level theorem; original uploaded implementation not independently executed
rows.result: All represented dyadic inputs, all outputs, deterministic relative l2 epsilon; O(N log N/log log N) word operations for fixed epsilon and epsilon=2^-ceil((log2 N)^beta), 0<beta<1.
rows.new_in_this_pass: Consolidated self-contained model, cost and error statement; sharpened precision-schedule qualification and primary-source comparison.
rows.novelty: Combined contract potentially useful; lookup/stability mechanisms classical; worldwide priority unconfirmed
limitations: Word RAM, not bit or exact-complex arithmetic
Variable precision exponent supplied or efficiently generated, with its cost charged

rows.title: All-length normwise Fourier compiler
rows.status: New completed project-level derivation, independently challenged at proof level
rows.result: Every integer N: same deterministic all-input relative-l2 contract and asymptotic fixed-epsilon/fixed-beta bound as F132; general supplied log(1/epsilon)=o(log N) gives o(N log N).
rows.new_in_this_pass: Explicit compact Fourier cutoff, centered embedding, alias-norm certificate, separated-grid Schur tails, fractional-offset coefficient tables and full 22epsilon/1024 error budget.
rows.cost: O(N n/log m+N log(1/epsilon)+N^(1/4)poly(n,p)+2^O(p)poly(n,p)); O(N) words; n=ceil(log2(N+1)),p=O(log n+log(1/epsilon)),m=Theta(n/p).
rows.novelty: Classical interpolation composition; theorem now established in project, external priority unconfirmed
limitations: Sufficiently large N main schedule; finite prefix uses charged fallback
Fixed-beta integer precision exponent supplied or efficiently generated, with its cost charged

rows.title: Sharp l2-only chirp-spectrum composition obstruction
rows.result: An error vector allowed by relative-l2 delta on the padded chirp FFT induces delta sqrt[N(2N-1)/M]=Theta(delta sqrt N) final error for a supported phase-aligned unit input.
rows.new_in_this_pass: Sharp restricted-input/output construction, rather than only a loose norm bound.
rows.novelty: Derived scope warning; no priority claim
limitations: Insufficiency of a black-box contract, not an actual worst case for deterministic F132
Does not rule out a better chirp-spectrum preparation or structured error proof

rows.title: Orthogonally certified structured-residual approximation
rows.status: Concrete compatible projector theorem; generic growing-fiber fusion conditional
rows.result: For U P=Pi U, support-projected independent errors satisfy ||error||²<=eta_s²||Px||²+eta_r²||(I-P)x||². Dyadic periodic averaging supplies an O(N) exact decomposition.
rows.new_in_this_pass: Avoids exact-field/finite-word mismatch using a concrete dyadic orthogonal projector.
rows.novelty: Classical projection/error decomposition; useful scoped project synthesis
limitations: Generic sparse-fiber recognizer does not automatically provide stable dyadic residual
